100 years calendar, covering the years 1850-1950: a coloured and illustrated promotional poster distributed with the compliments of Richardson Bros., Papakura, ca 1915

The centrepiece is a tabular calendar accompanied by notes on the method of reading it. Ranged around this are advertisements for a variety of South Auckland businesses. These include, from Pukekohe: Herb Brunton's Premier Hall (hairdresser and fancy goods);  J. Adams & Sons, family butchers; H. Dell & Son, saddle and harness makers; W. Wright, watchmaker and jeweller; Pukekohe House (tailors); Frank Perkins & Co., grocers; from Otahuhu: B. Jenkins, tailor; T. Jameson, bicycle builder and repairer; from Papatoetoe: J. Hunter, plumber; Frank H. Wells, building contractor; W.J. Dilworth, saddle and harness maker; G. Rawnsley, boot and shoe maker; S.E. Moe, 'Singer' motor cycles; from Papakura: A. Watson, boot and shoe emporium; the Papakura Hotel [with photograph]; Richardson Bros., Papakura Steam Joinery Factory [with photograph]; and from Manurewa: Grand View Accommodation House; D.R. Talbot & Sons, general storekeepers; there is also an advertisement for Amber Tips Tea.

The whole is outlined by a decorative border and the graphics include drawings of thistles, roses, a Maori chief, taiaha, kiwis, and a boy scout and girl guide. The illustrations are credited to V. Willott. Publisher: W. Smith & Co. (printed by Brett Printing Co.).
